ui.controls.tab: Tap a tile — walk there (tap it again to act)
ui.controls.arrows: Drag a list — scroll menus and panels
ui.controls.walk: ✥ Pad — tap to turn, hold to walk
ui.controls.e: ✋ Action — act on the tile in front of the crew member
ui.controls.b: 🏠 Base — base management and construction palette
ui.controls.x: PC mode, key X — presentation mode
ui.controls.z: PC mode, key Z — defeat demo
ui.walk.marsArrival: Explore Mars on foot. ⚒ Tools opens field actions and 🏠 Base opens the base. Build a self-sufficient colony and keep the link to Earth running. Dust can reduce solar power.
content.tutorial.reserves: Tap Reserves to show or hide them. From top to bottom, the icons show oxygen, water, food, power, and materials. The numbers tell you how much is left.
content.tutorial.t02: Without power nothing works. Face an open tile and tap ⚒ Tools to install a solar panel.
content.tutorial.t03: There is a mineral deposit near the ship. Tap it to walk there, then tap ✋ Action to collect it.
content.tutorial.t04: Sensors detect ice to the southeast. Tap the terrain in shadow, then tap ✋ Action to survey it.
content.tutorial.t05: Tap 🌙 End day to see what happened.
content.tutorial.t04random: Sensors detect ice somewhere near the base. Tap the terrain in shadow and use ✋ Action to explore it.
content.map.walk.fogAhead: Unexplored ground ahead. Tap ✋ Action to explore it ({ap} AP).
content.map.walk.controls: Tap the map or use ✥ to walk
content.map.walk.requiresRole: Only {role} can do this. Switch crew in ⚒ Tools.
content.map.walk.goal: Collect minerals or select a solar panel to build. Tap ✋ Action when facing the target.
content.map.journal.closeHint: Tap Close to return to the mission.
content.map.journal.activeRepairDetail: Damaged equipment at ({x}, {y}). Face it and tap ✋ Action to repair ({cost} materials, 1 AP).
content.map.look.fog: unexplored ground. Tap ✋ Action to explore it.
content.map.look.building.damaged: {name}, damaged. Tap ✋ Action to repair it.
content.map.look.building.off: {name}, switched off. Turn it on in 🏠 Base.
content.map.look.terrain.mineral: a mineral deposit. Tap ✋ Action to collect {n} materials.
content.map.advisor.tip.fix: Mission control: the {building} is not working. Switch it on in 🏠 Base or face it and tap ✋ Action to repair it.
